title: Impact of Data Sparsity on Machine Learning for Fault Detection in Power System Protection
abstract: arXiv:2505.15560v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Germany's transition to a renewable energy-based power system is reshaping grid operations, requiring advanced monitoring and control to manage decentralized generation. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful tool for power system protection, particularly for fault detection (FD) and fault line identification (FLI) in transmission grids. However, ML model reliability depends on data quality and availability. Data sparsity resulting from sensor failures, communication disruptions, or reduced sampling rates poses a challenge to ML-based FD and FLI. Yet, its impact has not been systematically validated prior to this work. In response, we propose a framework to assess the impact of data sparsity on ML-based FD and FLI performance. translated_title: 电力系统保护中数据稀疏性对机器学习故障检测的影响
translated_abstract: 德国向基于可再生能源的电力系统转型正在重塑电网运行，需要先进的监测和控制手段来管理分散式发电。机器学习（ML）已成为电力系统保护的强大工具，特别是在输电网的故障检测（FD）和故障线路识别（FLI）方面。然而，机器学习模型的可靠性取决于数据的质量和可用性。由传感器故障、通信中断或采样率降低所导致的数据稀疏性，对基于机器学习的故障检测和故障线路识别构成了挑战。然而，在本研究之前，其影响尚未得到系统性验证。为此，我们提出了一个评估数据稀疏性对基于机器学习的故障检测和故障线路识别性能影响的框架。我们模拟了真实的数据稀疏性场景，评估其影响，得出定量见解，并通过将该评估策略应用于现有的基于机器学习的系统来证明其有效性。
tldr: 提出了一个评估框架，系统性地量化了数据稀疏性对基于机器学习的电力系统故障检测与故障线路识别性能的影响。
en_tdlr: Proposes an evaluation framework to systematically quantify the impact of data sparsity on ML-based fault detection and fault line identification performance in power system protection.
